public_rationale: The fair contextual test is whether the Senate approved mandatory independent review before AI products reached the market. Individual proposals cannot refute that institutional claim. The records show a relevant proposal in 2025 and a blocked passage attempt on September 29, 2026. These findings lean toward Marcus's reading, but they do not establish the absence of every qualifying Senate-passed measure across the full period. limitations: The result depends on reading 'did nothing' in its surrounding discussion of mandatory independent review.
Failure of a particular bill is not proof that no other qualifying measure passed.
Contemporary reporting corroborates the recent failure but cannot replace a complete legislative record.
